mechanism: Eslicarbazepine may induce CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially reducing adalimumab exposure through increased metabolism, while TNF-alpha inhibitors like adalimumab may increase infection risk when combined with enzyme-inducing antiepileptics.
action: Monitor therapeutic efficacy of adalimumab and watch for signs of reduced efficacy or breakthrough inflammation; counsel on infection signs; consider alternative antiepileptic if possible or ensure adequate adalimumab dosing.
